rules.E153-B2: bias, int8 (the critic's B2): as B1, the 12 priority-1 int8 kinds (at least 6)
rules.E153-C1: coverage, power (the critic's): kinds inside M8's frozen 95% band among the 30 priority-1 kinds; PASS if at least the 2.5% point of Binomial(n, 0.95) (26 of 30), FAIL if fewer; NOT SCORED under 10
